title: Keyboard-first navigation
description: Create a logical keyboard path using native links, a skip link, visible focus and activation that works without mouse-only event handlers.
objectives: Build a logical DOM-based keyboard traversal path
Use a skip link that reaches a focusable main region
Use semantic buttons for actions and anchors for navigation
Inspect visible focus and activate controls with keyboard input
rubric: I navigated the whole page using only keyboard controls.
I verified a functional skip link and visible focus indicator.
I passed static and Chromium keyboard activation tests.
